text.tspan: the only process that sees the credentials
anything is written to the home
owned by the user, written as the user
QGIS Python console, full shell access

div.p: Downloads land in a staging directory first, so a ../ in an object key cannot escape into the filesystem.
The copy into the home runs as uid 1000, so a delivery cannot write anywhere the user could not write themselves, and everything delivered ends up owned by them.

The credentials never leave root: 0400 root:root, and scrubbed from the environment before the session starts. A user with a Python console still cannot enumerate the bucket or reach anyone else's prefix.
The staging directory is 0755 on purpose — an earlier umask 077 made it unreadable and broke the delivery. There is a regression test for it.
